facts.statement: The genus Halszkaraptor contains only one known species, Halszkaraptor escuilliei.
facts.quote: It contains only one known species, Halszkaraptor escuilliei.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor was named and described in 2017 by a team of researchers including Andrea Cau, Pascal Godefroit, and Rinchen Barsbold.
facts.quote: The type species Halszkaraptor escuilliei was in 2017 named and described by Andrea Cau, Vincent Beyrand, Dennis F. A. E. Voeten, Vincent Fernandez, Paul Tafforeau, Koen Stein, Rinchen Barsbold, Khishigjav Tsogtbaatar, Philip John Currie, and Pascal Godefroit.

facts.statement: The holotype fossil dates to the late Campanian, approximately seventy-five million years ago.
facts.quote: The holotype, MPC D-102/109, was found in a layer of orange sandstone of the Bayn Dzak Member of the Djadochta Formation, dating from the late Campanian, about seventy-five million years old.

facts.statement: The fossil was eventually returned to Mongolian authorities after being held by collectors and dealers.
facts.quote: The fossil was returned to the Mongolian authorities.

facts.statement: The holotype skeleton represents a subadult individual that was about one year old.
facts.quote: It represents a subadult individual, about one year old.

facts.statement: The holotype had a head about 7 cm long, a neck 20 cm long, a back 13 cm long, and a sacrum 5 cm long.
facts.quote: The head was about 7 cm long, the neck 20 cm, the back 13 cm and the sacrum 5 cm.

facts.statement: The premaxilla forms a flattened snout that occupies 32% of the total snout length.
facts.quote: The premaxilla, the front snout bone, forms a flattened snout, occupying 32% of the snout length.

facts.statement: The premaxilla bears eleven teeth.
facts.quote: The premaxilla bears eleven teeth.

facts.statement: The total number of vertebrae in the neck and back is twenty-two.
facts.quote: The number of vertebrae of the neck and back totals twenty-two.

facts.statement: The snout is transversely expanded at the front, creating a spoon-shaped profile when viewed from above.
facts.quote: The snout, though elongated, is transversely expanded in front, creating a spoon-shaped profile in top view.

facts.statement: The snout's width is 180% of its height.
facts.quote: Its width is 180% of its height.

facts.statement: Each premaxilla bears eleven teeth, which is a record for the entire Dinosauria.
facts.quote: Each premaxilla bears eleven teeth, a record among the entire Dinosauria.

facts.statement: The neck length represents half of the snout-sacrum length, the highest value known for any Mesozoic paravian.
facts.quote: This implies that it represents half of the snout-sacrum length, a value that is the highest for all known Mesozoic paravians.

facts.statement: The holotype displays evidence of a semiaquatic lifestyle, though some researchers question this ecology.
facts.quote: The type specimen (holotype) has been compared to the bones of extant crocodilians and aquatic birds, and displayed evidence of a semiaquatic lifestyle, while some researchers question a semiaquatic ecology.

facts.statement: Neurovascular channels in the premaxilla probably housed electro-sensory organs.
facts.quote: These channels probably housed electro-sensory organs.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Halszkaraptor had a semiaquatic ecology.
facts.quote: while some researchers question a semiaquatic ecology.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor was classified within the family Dromaeosauridae in 2017.
facts.quote: Halszkaraptor was placed in the Dromaeosauridae in 2017.

facts.statement: A new subfamily named Halszkaraptorinae was created to include Halszkaraptor and its relatives Hulsanpes and Mahakala.
facts.quote: A new clade Halszkaraptorinae was coined, containing Halszkaraptor and its close relatives Hulsanpes and Mahakala.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis determined that Halszkaraptorinae represents the most basal known group of dromaeosaurids.
facts.quote: The analysis showed that Halszkaraptorinae was the basalmost known dromaeosaurid group.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor lived during the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: fossil_range: Cretácico Superior

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor lived approximately 75 to 71 million years ago during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente entre 75 a 71 millones de años, durante el Campaniense en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor was about 60 centimeters long, roughly the size of a mallard duck.
facts.quote: Halszkaraptor tenía un tamaño cercano al de un ánade real, alrededor de 60 centímetros de largo

facts.statement: The premaxilla, the bone at the front of the snout, was flattened and occupied 32% of the snout's length.
facts.quote: El premaxilar, el hueso del frente del hocico, tiene una apariencia aplanada, y ocupa el 32% de la longitud del hocico.

facts.statement: Scientists used synchrotron scanning on the fossil to find evidence of a semi-aquatic lifestyle in the bones.
facts.quote: Los científicos usaron un escáner de sincotrón con el fósil y hallaron que los huesos mostraban indicios de un estilo de vida semiacuático

facts.statement: The descending ramus of the postorbital bone in Halszkaraptor has a rod-like shape.
facts.quote: El ramo descendente del hueso postorbital tiene forma de varilla.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor's neck vertebrae had extremely reduced neural spines, appearing as low crests on the second to fifth vertebrae and being completely absent on posterior cervical vertebrae.
facts.quote: Las vértebras del cuello tienen apófisis neurales sumamente reducidas: de la segunda a la quinta vértebra estas son solo crestas bajas y las vértebras cervicales posteriores carecen de ellas por completo.

facts.statement: On the second to fifth cervical vertebrae, the postzygapophyses, which normally occur in pairs, fused into a single lobe-shaped process.
facts.quote: De la segunda a a la quinta vértebra cervical, las postzigapófisis que normalmente irían en pares se han fusionado en un único proceso en forma de lóbulo.

facts.statement: The chevrons at the base of Halszkaraptor's tail were large and had a pentagonal profile.
facts.quote: Los cheurones de la base de la cola son grandes con un perfil pentagonal.

facts.statement: The first phalanx of the third finger in Halszkaraptor's hand was 47% the length of the third metacarpal.
facts.quote: La primera falange del tercer dedo de la mano tiene el 47% de la longitud del tercer metacarpiano.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor had a shovel-shaped snout profile when viewed from above.
facts.quote: El hocico, aunque alargado, se halla expandido transversalmente en el frente, creando un perfil en forma de cuchara al ser visto desde arriba.

facts.statement: Its expanded snout area consisted of a relatively long premaxilla bone internally perforated by a system of air chambers.
facts.quote: El área expandida consiste de un premaxilar relativamente largo. Este hueso se halla perforado internamente por un sistema de cámaras aéreas.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest the vascular channels in the snout likely housed electrosensory organs.
facts.quote: Estos canales probablemente alojaron órganos electrosensoriales.

facts.statement: Each premaxilla of Halszkaraptor had eleven teeth, the highest number recorded for that bone among all dinosaurs.
facts.quote: Cada premaxilar tiene once dientes, lo cual es el máximo número registrado en ese hueso entre todos los dinosaurios.

facts.statement: Its maxilla contained an estimated twenty to twenty-five robust teeth that curved only at their tips and were spaced further apart.
facts.quote: Los dientes del maxilar, cuyo número se estima entre veinte a veinticinco, son más robustos, curvándose solo en sus puntas y se encuentran mucho más distanciados entre sí.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor's neck was extremely long, equivalent to 290% of the skull length and 150% of the back length.
facts.quote: El cuello es sumamente alargado. Equivale al 290% de la longitud del cráneo y al 150% de la longitud del dorso.

facts.statement: The extreme neck length was achieved by elongating individual vertebrae rather than having a high number of them.
facts.quote: Esta longitud no es generada por un gran número de vértebras, como ocurre en Oviraptorosauria, sino por el alargamiento de las vértebras individuales.

facts.statement: The sixth cervical vertebra was the longest, being four times longer than it was tall.
facts.quote: La sexta vértebra cervical es la más larga, siendo cuatro veces más larga que alta.

facts.statement: Unlike more derived Eudromaeosaurians, Halszkaraptor's tail was not stiffened by zygapophyses or elongated chevrons.
facts.quote: A diferencia de lo que se observa en los Eudromaeosauria más derivados, la cola no se mantenía rígida por la presencia de zigapófisis o cheurones alargados.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor possessed adaptations for both terrestrial and aquatic life, including strong hind legs for running and paddle-like forelimbs for swimming.
facts.quote: Halszkaraptor tenía características que le permitían pasar tiempo tanto en tierra como en el agua, incluyendo sus fuertes extremidades posteriores para correr y extremidades delanteras relativamente cortas y en forma de remo para nadar.

facts.statement: Its short tail likely shifted the center of gravity forward, an adaptation more useful for swimming than walking.
facts.quote: La corta cola habría llevado el centro de gravedad más hacia el frente, lo cual es más útil para nadar que para caminar.

facts.statement: Scientists believe Halszkaraptor hunted aquatic prey based on its sharp backward-curving teeth, long neck, and potential for detecting water vibrations via snout sensors.
facts.quote: Tenía muchos dientes afilados y curvados hacia atrás en su boca, un cuello largo y evidencia de tener sensores neuronales a lo largo del hocico que le pudieron haber permitido detectar vibraciones en el agua, llevando a pensar a los científicos que cazaba presas acuáticas.

facts.statement: The holotype of Halszkaraptor likely originated from the Djadochta Formation in Ukha Tolgod, southern Mongolia, and was illegally removed by fossil traffickers.
facts.quote: El holotipo de Halszkaraptor probablemente es originario de la Formación Djadochta en Ukha Tolgod, en el sur de Mongolia, y fue retirado ilegalmente por traficantes de fósiles.

facts.statement: The holotype was found in an orange sandstone layer of the Bayn Dzak Member of the Djadochta Formation, dating to the late Campanian.
facts.quote: El holotipo, MPC D-102/109, fue hallado en una capa de arenisca naranja del Miembro Bayn Dzak Member de la Formación Djadochta, que data de finales de la época del Campaniense.

facts.statement: The species Halszkaraptor escuilliei was named and described in 2017 by a team including Andrea Cau, Pascal Godefroit, and Rinchen Barsbold.
facts.quote: La especie tipo Halszkaraptor escuilliei fue nombrada y descrita en 2017 por Andrea Cau, Vincent Beyrand, Dennis F. A. E. Voeten, Vincent Fernandez, Paul Tafforeau, Koen Stein, Rinchen Barsbold, Khishigjav Tsogtbaatar, Philip John Currie y Pascal Godefroit.

facts.statement: The genus name honors the late Polish paleontologist Halszka Osmólska and the Latin word 'raptor,' meaning 'thief'.
facts.quote: El nombre del género es una referencia en honor a la difunta paleontóloga polaca Halszka Osmólska, por sus grandes contribuciones a la paleontología de los terópodos, en particular los de Mongolia como Hulsanpes, y el término en latín raptor, "ladrón".

facts.statement: Fossil traffickers had only exposed the left side of the skeleton before it was acquired by science.
facts.quote: El trabajo hecho por los traficantes de fósiles solo había llegado al punto de exponer el lado izquierdo del esqueleto.

facts.statement: The skeleton was mostly articulated and uncompressed, representing a semi-adult individual approximately one year old.
facts.quote: El esqueleto está articulado en su mayor parte y no está comprimido. Este corresponde a un individuo semiadulto, de cerca de un año de edad.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor was placed in Dromaeosauridae and assigned to the new subfamily Halszkaraptorinae, which also includes Hulsanpes and Mahakala.
facts.quote: Halszkaraptor se incluyó en Dromaeosauridae, en su descripción de 2017, debido a sus características únicas, se acuñó una nueva subfamilia a la que llamaron Halszkaraptorinae , que contiene además de Halszkaraptor a sus parientes cercanos Hulsanpes y Mahakala.

facts.statement: Research indicated that Halszkaraptorinae was the most basal known group within Dromaeosauridae.
facts.quote: El trabajo mostró que Halszkaraptorinae era el grupo más basal conocido de Dromaeosauridae.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: The top profile of Halszkaraptor's snout was hollow when viewed from the side.
facts.quote: El perfil superior en vista lateral está hueco.

facts.statement: The premaxillary teeth were grouped very closely, touching each other, and were very long, curving gradually backward.
facts.quote: Estos dientes se agrupan muy cercanamente, tocándose entre sí, y son muy alargados, curvándose gradualmente hacia atrás.

facts.statement: Halszkaraptor's cervical ribs were short, not longer than the bodies of the vertebrae.
facts.quote: Las costillas cervicales son cortas, no más largas que los cuerpos de las vértebras.

facts.statement: It is notable that Halszkaraptor is one of only two known non-avian dinosaurs adapted to a semi-aquatic lifestyle, alongside spinosaurids and Natovenator.
facts.quote: Los únicos otros dinosaurios no avianos que se sabe estaban adaptados a un modo de vida semiacuático son los espinosáuridos, y los Natovenator.
